# Intwish

> Intwish is a digital innovation company building gamified training, AI-powered assessment and immersive simulation platforms for banks, telecoms, energy, government and education. HQ Dubai (UAE), registered in Pakistan, UAE, Canada and Indonesia. 300,000+ professionals assessed across 5 markets in 10 years, including drives of 25,000+ candidates in days.

## Key pages

- [intOS — the virtual OS assessment platform](https://intwish.com/products/intos): A virtual-desktop assessment platform simulating the working world — email simulations, team messenger, situational-judgement meetings, psychometric games and an interlinked narrative engine. Used for management-trainee and graduate drives of 4,000–25,000+ candidates.
- [IntReview — AI-assisted interviews & assessments](https://intwish.com/products/intreview): Asynchronous video interviews scored by AI against client competency rubrics, with proctoring, STAR analysis and instant evidence-quoted reports.
- [Case studies](https://intwish.com/case-studies): 16 quantified deployments — Bank Alfalah (7,000+ employees trained), PTCL (25,000+ candidates in days), HBL (first 3D recruitment simulation), ICI Pakistan, Faysal Bank, K-Electric, Shell, Saudi Business Center and more.
- [Insights & research](https://intwish.com/insights): Benchmark reports, whitepapers and industry playbooks from 300,000+ assessments — gamified assessment completion (90%+ vs 60–70% for traditional tests), SJT and game-based validity evidence, ROI frameworks and banking/telecom/energy/government playbooks.

## Services

- [Training & Learning](https://intwish.com/services/training-learning): Gamified compliance, onboarding and capability training that employees actually finish.
- [Recruitment & Assessment](https://intwish.com/services/recruitment-assessment): High-volume gamified hiring with 3D simulations, cognitive games and automated candidate reports.
- [Employee Engagement](https://intwish.com/services/employee-engagement): High-potential identification and culture-building games.
- [Enterprise Portals & Automation](https://intwish.com/services/enterprise-portals): Government-grade portals, knowledge bases and mystery-shopper evaluations.
- [360° Feedback Systems](https://intwish.com/services/feedback-360): Anonymous multi-rater feedback with automated 20-page reports.
- [AR/VR Simulation](https://intwish.com/services/ar-vr-simulation): Immersive 3D training and assessment environments.
